skills.name: Composite - Fasten an object with power tool
skills.description: Use a power tool to fasten an object to a surface using fixing hardware. Assumes that the object has been positioned on the surface.

steps.activity: Position the fixing_hardware on the object_to_fasten
Position the power_tool at the fixing_hardware
Pull the trigger of the power_tool
Push the fixing_hardware through the object_to_fasten and into the fastening_surface using the power_tool
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Fasten a wing wham to wall studs with screws and an power screwdriver
Fasten roof flashing to a wall with screws and an power screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Loosen an object with a power tool
skills.description: Use a power tool to loosen an object from a surface

steps.activity: Position the power_tool at the fixing_hardware
Pull the trigger of the power_tool
Pull the fixing_hardware out of the fastening_surface and through the object_to_loosen using the power_tool
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Remove the screws from an electrical panel cover with a power screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Fasten an object with a handheld screwdriver
skills.description: Rotate a screwdriver by hand to fasten an object to a surface.

steps.activity: Position the screwdriver at the screw on the object_to_fasten
Rotate screwdriver to drive the screw into the fastening_surface
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Push the screwdriver to driver the screw forward
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Tighten a hose clamp on a pipe with a screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Loosen an object with a handheld screwdriver
skills.description: Rotate a screwdriver by hand to loosen an object from a surface.

steps.activity: Position the screwdriver at the screw on the object_to_loosen
Rotate screwdriver to loosen the screw from the fastening_surface
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Pull the screwdriver to pull the screw out of the fastening_surface
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Loosen a terminal screw with a handheld screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Fasten an electrical wire to a terminal with a screwdriver
skills.description: Position a wire in a terminal and rotate a screwdriver to fasten the wire to the terminal.

steps.activity: Position the wire_to_fasten in the terminal
Rotate the screwdriver to tighten the terminal screw and fasten the wire_to_fasten to the terminal
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

examples: Fasten a wire to a circuit breaker terminal with a screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Loosen an electrical wire from a terminal with a screwdriver
skills.description: Rotate a screwdriver to loosen a terminal screw and remove the wire from the terminal.

steps.activity: Rotate the screwdriver to loosen the terminal screw holding the wire_to_loosen in the terminal
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Pull the wire_to_loosen out of the terminal
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Loosen a wire from a circuit breaker terminal with a screwdriver
